title: Chapter 12: Taking Advantage Of The Weird
content:
Chapter 12: Taking Advantage Of The Weird

Hu Tu's departure will surely cause another storm.

The whole army of the bugbears was annihilated, and this time Wu Qing had time to clean up the battlefield.

Since he had come into contact with native creatures, the materials in this world had value, and he had to take back everything that needed to be cleaned up.

The puppies and hydralisks were combat tools, but they were not good at cleaning up the battlefield. Wu Qing increased the number of worker bees to 60 and sent them to clean up the battlefield and the bugbears' camp.

The worker bees were professional mining and transportation tools for the Zerg, and were most suitable for doing these things.

After a big battle, the system's resources were replenished. Wu Qing built two more mother nests, increasing the number of mother nests to 10, and expanding the Zerg's territory to half of the valley area.

Google search for TWKAN

Continue to build a suitable number of colonies to evolve defensive spikes and anti-aircraft towers, improve the territory's defense system, and prepare for various crises that may occur at night.

The remaining resources were used to replenish the number of each type of troops.

First hatch enough hosts, then hatch hydralisks according to the amount of qi, and hatch puppies with the remaining energy.

Wu Qing returned to the Zerg territory, consumed 200 energy points and 100 gas points, and produced a stronger biological colonization suit for his own use.

After the various units of the Zerg were arranged properly, Wu Qing entered the mother nest and began to consider his own strength.

Wu Qing found that it was not as easy to improve the strength of this world as in the world he was originally in.

Now that he has sufficient system resources, he uses the energy provided by the mother nest to practice, and the speed of practice is faster, but the scene of the breakthrough he imagined did not appear.

The strength is improving, but the breakthrough is still far away.

"Is it that the rules of heaven and earth in this world have changed? Or has the upper limit of the strength of the creatures in this world increased?"

Wu Qing was puzzled, and there was no answer to these questions for the time being.

"Maybe when I come into contact with the practice system of this world, everything will be clear."

Since the way to quickly improve his own strength is not feasible, he can only focus on the development of the Zerg.

Wu Qing is going to have a good sleep first, get enough energy, and then play with the sticky weirdness at night.

When he woke up, it was almost dusk.

The Zerg territory is under the auxiliary control of the queen, and everything is in order.

The battlefield has been cleared, and all valuable things have been transported back to the Zerg territory.

The number of main combat units, hydralisks, has reached 100, and the number of puppies has increased to more than 500.

Wu Qing walked out of the mother nest, stretched his body, and performed a set of body-building boxing.

He ordered all Zerg outside the territory to rush back and gather at the edge of the territory.

The Zerg in the territory also walked out of the territory under Wu Qing's order and moved freely in the edge of the territory.

This is because Wu Qing saw that the resources provided by the weird that can possess are considerable, and he tasted the sweetness and wanted to continue to fleece the weird.

This is also a test of the weird.

The sky darkened, and the whole world seemed to be covered with a layer of fog, becoming gloomy and weird, full of ominousness.

When the Zerg wandering outside the territory feel something strange, they enter the territory. The anti-stealth ability of the air defense tower and the host rule level can make everything show its true form.

The possessed weird that looks like a black tentacle monster will be killed by the host's mental attack when it enters the territory.

This kind of possessed weird is not strong in itself, and its mental power is not strong, but the resources it provides are still considerable.

Hundreds of Zergs ran back and forth twice in and out of the territory, and no more possessed weirds possessed Zergs.

I don't know if the nearby possessed weirds have been consumed, or they have become smarter.

Seeing that no fish can be caught, Wu Qing ordered all Zergs to return to the territory and burrow underground to rest and recover.

The previous wave of possessed weirds was just an appetizer. Wu Qing was still waiting for the big guy who played with him all night yesterday.

Sure enough, not long after, the weird laughter outside the territory sounded.

"Let's see what tricks you can play this time. Will you sing for me all night again?"

Wu Qing looked at the night sky outside the territory and said provocatively.

The twisted weird he expected did not appear, and it seemed that the same routine weird did not like to use it a second time.

The sky and the ground were quiet, nothing happened.

Today, the big guys outside the territory were smiling all the time, no crying, no cursing, no teasing.

Just when Wu Qing thought that the weirdo couldn't play any new tricks tonight, the sky around the entire territory suddenly became darker, and a few black clouds were floating faintly.

When the black clouds got closer, they were all flying creatures like bats yesterday, a large group of them, too many to count.

"What are you trying to do? Do you want to consume the Queen's spiritual power?"

Yesterday, the Queen's spiritual shock knocked down a large number of flying creatures. Maybe this weirdo saw that the Queen's spiritual power was used in a rough and wasteful way, so he wanted to consume it today.

"Unfortunately, today is different from the past, you made a wrong calculation again."

This weird guess is not wrong. Although the spiritual power of the collective consciousness of the Zerg is powerful, according to the law of conservation of energy, no matter how strong the energy is, it is limited. Use it as little as possible and keep it as a trump card for critical moments.

There was no need for the Queen to take action, as the Zerg territory had already built a new defense system, and the number of air defense towers had increased significantly.

Most importantly, the Zerg had 100 more Hydralisks.

When the anti-aircraft towers began to attack, 100 hydralisks emerged from the ground throughout the territory and launched an attack on the enemies in the air.

The flying speed of the host is very fast. He is a transport unit. Although the speed has not been upgraded yet, it is enough.

Wu Qing did not want them to participate in the battle, so they took the initiative to gather in the center of the territory to avoid the enemy's sharp edge.

Although the number of flying creatures created by Weirdness is large, their strength is very weak. A single attack from the air defense tower can destroy a large area, and the attack effect of the Hydralisk is also very good.

These flying creatures were beaten like headless flies and fell down in pieces. When they fell into the Zerg territory, the puppies who had been eyeing them eagerly pounced on them.

There are also defensive ground thorns everywhere. On the ground, they have nowhere to escape.

Seeing that there was nothing he could do, Wei Wei began to cry again, and soon he was cursing and cursing.

"This weird character is quite like a child. He smiles at the beginning, cries when he can't beat him, scolds when no one cares about him when he cries, and the most important thing is that he is a clinging little scoundrel."

Wu Qing found that this strange situation was about to enter yesterday's state again, and he suddenly felt dumbfounded.

After clearing away the enemies coming from the air, Wu Qing used the resources he had just obtained to continue sending out Hydralisks.

The all-rounder Hydralisk is more suitable as the backbone of the Zerg combat force.

It was a long night, and Wu Qing was going to explore the mysterious details tonight. He gathered a bunch of hosts together and explored along the edge of the Zerg territory.

Even if the host has a rule-level anti-stealth ability, after wandering around for half the night, nothing was found.

"This is weird, really weird!"

Wu Qing had to sigh.
